pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: The Bronze Cauldron is a more advanced forging vessel with greater material capacity and an operable lid. Its sturdier construction allows refiners to work with more complex combinations of spiritual materials.

pages.title: Compendium Account
pages.text: To access its contents, the lid must first be opened.

pages.title: Operating the Cauldron
pages.text: Shift + Right-click: Open or close the lid.

pages.title: Operating the Cauldron
pages.text: Right-click with the lid open: Access the forging interface.
